candidate.name: Alotau
candidate.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Alotau geo tag (town centre; a town, not an attraction)
candidate.note: Town: provincial capital and gateway to Milne Bay on a natural harbour, with a waterfront, a produce and seafood market, the Turnbull WWII memorial park and the dive trade. The annual Kenu and Kundu Festival is an event, so it is not a spot (mentioned here only).

candidate.name: Fergusson Island
candidate.note: Island: geothermal volcanic island reached only by boat, with trekking trails and birdwatching for a rare bird-of-paradise and the Curl-crested Manucode; its hot springs at Deidei are listed separately.

candidate.name: Goodenough Island
candidate.note: Island: volcanic island of the D'Entrecasteaux group with rainforest, waterfalls, Mount Vineuo and good birdwatching; named as an unspoilt island to explore and a tour destination from Alotau.

candidate.name: Louisiade Archipelago
candidate.note: Archipelago: about 100 islands in the far southeast of Milne Bay, a diver's paradise and yachting destination with coral reefs; few visitors and reached mainly by private yacht, so a region rather than a single stop.

candidate.name: Misima Island
candidate.note: Island: the most populated and most accessible Louisiade island, served by air to Bwagaoia with a guest house; a closed gold mine and island-hopping stop named by the PNG tourism authority.
